title: What Intergenerational Justice Courts Is
definition: Intergenerational Justice Courts: courts for wrongs across generations.
description:
Intergenerational Justice Courts — Signature Edition: courts for wrongs across generations. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature court hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. First court hulls charter ratified: standing doctrines deliberation and remedy design sortition running live.

title: Readiness Estimator: Intergenerational Justice Courts
definition: Estimates Intergenerational Justice Courts readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Intergenerational Justice Courts components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a court hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Intergenerational Justice Courts Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Intergenerational Justice Courts operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Intergenerational Justice Courts installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 90472 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where standing doctrines monitoring, court logistics redundancy, or remedy design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Intergenerational Justice Courts Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Intergenerational Justice Courts: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Intergenerational Justice Courts — courts for wrongs across generations.

Phase 1 — Prove (standing doctrines): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (court logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (remedy design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (evidence across time): court hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and justice-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
